item.title: ‘Country’ Joe McDonald, ’60s rock star, proud protest counterculture icon, dies at 84
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — “Country” Joe McDonald, a hippie rock star of the 1960s whose “I-Feel-Like-I’m-Fixin’-To-Die Rag” was a four-lettered rebuke to the Vietnam War that became an anthem for protesters and a highlight of the Woodstock music festival, died Sunday. item.title: New Westminster police warn residents about ‘suspicious glue markings’ on doors
item.description: New Westminster police are out with a warning for residents after "suspicious glue markings" were discovered on several doors in an apartment building.

item.title: Kelowna RCMP seizes weapons, drugs, and cash from known ‘problem residence’
item.description: The Kelowna RCMP says its Crime Reduction Unit executed a search warrant at a home March 4, resulting in a significant seizure of weapons, drugs, and cash.
